source_metadata.title: AVAILABILITY AND USE OF NON-PRESCRIBED BUPRENORPHINE-NALOXONE IN A CANADIAN SETTING, 2014–2020

notes: No exact duplicate atom_id/canonical-statement pairs were found. Immediate and delayed availability models are intentionally represented as distinct outcome assertions.

extraction_limitations: The extraction represents study-generated methods, findings, limitations, disclosures, and author conclusions; citation-only background claims were not re-expressed as if generated by this study.

Table 1 baseline bivariate odds ratios were not atomized exhaustively because they are descriptive baseline comparisons rather than the longitudinal multivariable findings central to the study question.
The paper reports only 17 participants with non-prescribed BUP-NX use, preventing modeled analysis of that use outcome; no unreported estimates were inferred.
No external sources were used to update or verify current buprenorphine prescribing policy; the atoms reflect the 2022 source only.
